# Supabase browser SDK

Vendored UMD bundle of @supabase/supabase-js 2.117.2, fetched from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2 on 2026-10-05. MIT license. Stored locally to remove the parser-blocking dependency on a third-party CDN during page startup. Same bundle formerly loaded through the @2 CDN route; no API change.
